mcp_tools.title: Electrical machines expert advice
mcp_tools.description: Submits an electrical-machines SME advice record (engagement, family-gated machine analysis, drives, protection, standards and hazardous areas, calculations, documents and disclosure) and returns a deterministic SOUND / NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including skill-vocabulary checks for machine family, control mode and ANSI device numbers, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared advice record; it gives no engineering advice.

inputSchema.description: The machines-advice manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

expect.notes: All mandatory fields for induction machine without VFD/protection/hazloc/calculations/docs are present and true. Computed starting current multiple: 6.000000.

computed_spot_checks.summary: 44 pass, 0 fail, 0 missing of 44 checks across seven sections.
